## Combo 1558-2557-3478-3875-4231
Cards: Time Sieve + Academy Manufactor + Parallel Lives + Dimir Aqueduct + Tireless Provisioner
Color identity: BGU | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 5 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Time Sieve (battlefield); Academy Manufactor (battlefield); Parallel Lives (battlefield); Dimir Aqueduct (hand); Tireless Provisioner (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
Steps: Play Dimir Aqueduct.
  When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
  Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
  Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
  Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Repeat each turn.

  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
  When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Start: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods (battlefield); Famished Worldsire (battlefield); Eldrazi Confluence (hand); Possessed Skaab (battlefield); Archelos, Lagoon Mystic (battlefield: untapped)
Prerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
  Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Possessed Skaab and Famished Worldsire.
  As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
  When Lumra, Possessed Skaab and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
  Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
  Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
  Repeat.
Notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Possessed Skaab and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

  Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Kheru Goldkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  The token Kheru Goldkeeper and Twilight Diviner's second ability triggers.
  Resolve the Twilight Diviner trigger, creating a token copy of Kheru Goldkeeper.
  Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
  Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
  Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
  Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Twilight Diviner and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Each Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
  Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
  Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
  Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Twilight Diviner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Each Kheru Goldkeeper and Twilight Diviner's first ability trigger.
  Resolve each Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
  Resolve the Twilight Diviner trigger, causing you to surveil 2.
  Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
  Repeat from step 20.
Notes: To get infinite creature tokens, you must use a creature with mana value 2 or less. You then want to alternate sacrificing Kheru Goldkeeper, Twilight Diviner and that creature. Twilight Diviner's second ability will reset each time it's returned, allowing for additional creature tokens of either Kheru Goldkeeper or the other creature.
